title: Turnaround and Expedite Schedule for Belrose Appraisal and Gemological Services
content:
# Turnaround and Expedite Schedule

For each service of Belrose Appraisal and Gemological Services, the turnaround in business days, the expedited turnaround, the surcharge for expediting, the notice a customer must give to expedite and the business days an outside laboratory takes where the service uses one are fixed as follows.

| Service | Turnaround, business days | Expedited turnaround, business days | Expedite surcharge, per cent of the quoted fee | Minimum notice to expedite, calendar days | Outside laboratory turnaround, business days |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Verbal Counter Estimate | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Insurance Replacement Appraisal | 7 | 3 | 40 | 3 | 0 |
| Fair Market Value Appraisal | 10 | 4 | 40 | 5 | 0 |
| Estate and Probate Appraisal | 15 | 7 | 35 | 7 | 0 |
| Certified Gemological Laboratory Report | 25 | 12 | 50 | 14 | 20 |
| Collection Portfolio Appraisal | 30 | 14 | 30 | 21 | 20 |

## Notes to the schedule

1. **Turnaround** is the number of business days between the piece being taken in and the report being issued.
2. **Expedited turnaround** is the number of business days the report is issued within when the engagement is expedited.
3. **Expedite surcharge** is expressed as a percentage of the quoted fee for the engagement, never of the base fee alone.
4. **Minimum notice to expedite** is counted in calendar days, not business days, and is the notice needed before an engagement can be expedited.
5. **Outside laboratory turnaround** is the number of business days the outside laboratory takes; it is nil at the four services that send nothing out.

## Questions the schedule answers

**Which figure is the surcharge a share of?** The quoted fee for the engagement. At the Insurance Replacement Appraisal that share is 40 per cent; at the Collection Portfolio Appraisal it is 30 per cent.

**Are the two notice columns in the same unit?** No. Turnaround columns are in business days; the notice column is in calendar days.

**Which services carry a laboratory turnaround?** Only the Certified Gemological Laboratory Report and the Collection Portfolio Appraisal, each at 20 business days.
